description: Domain overview (Semrush type=domain_ranks): high-level SEO/PPC summary for a domain. Returns parsed rows with columns: Db (database), Dn (domain), Rk (Semrush rank), Or (organic keywords count), Ot (organic traffic), Oc (organic traffic cost), Ad (adwords/paid keywords count), At (paid traffic), Ac (paid traffic cost). Consumes your Semrush API units.

_apiKey.description: Your own Semrush API key (BYO). Passed to Semrush as the `key` query param. Consumes your Semrush API units.

database.description: 2-letter Semrush regional database (e.g. us, uk, de, fr, es, ca, au). Default us.

name: domain_overview
